programs.desc: Among natural freaks, the victory most often goes to the most deadly and cunning individuals.Survival is often determined by unconventional action.In nature, weirdness pays off.

programs.title: America's Wild Spaces
programs.desc: A story about the untamed forces of nature, danger and natural wonders that can be discovered in the wildest regions of America.Viewers, together with the creators of the series, will visit Everglades National Park, the Grand Canyon, Death Valley, Glacier National Park and Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.Even though all these places seem to be well-known and explored, each of them hides its own secrets.A journey in the footsteps of wild America will go far beyond guidebooks.Areas will be explored where humans are still guests and must absolutely obey the rules of nature.

programs.title: Animal Genius
programs.desc: Biologist Liz Bonnin has been revealing the secrets of the fauna kingdom for years.In this film, he observes animals that are very good at fighting predators, even though they do not have sharp claws and fangs.Their survival is related to skills such as communication and cooperation.It turns out that nature still hides many secrets from us.The observed animals surprise scientists who make new discoveries.This time they will learn patents for survival, including:in Africa and Mexico.There is strength in a herd. Charming meerkats have already been the heroines of many documentaries and TV series.Curious mammals living in the Kalahari Desert are exposed to attacks by predators.They can inform each other about various threats.Their characteristic sound signals are crucial.Viewers will also watch the battle between Matabele warrior ants and termites.Unusual insects can provide first aid to injured companions.In Mexico, Liz Bonnin will observe sea turtles.The small reptiles face a dangerous journey to the ocean.They move towards the water together, increasing their chances of survival.These scenes show that in nature, it is not only the strongest who survive, but also the best connected.

programs.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programs.desc: We discover eight different species of octopuses in the depths of the sea.Each has a unique personality and great intelligence.Despite drastic differences, these animals turn out to be surprisingly similar to humans.

programs.title: Animal Fight Club
programs.desc: In this episode we will see animal hunters carefully preparing a battle plan.We will see that an attacker's intelligence can make the difference between victory and death.We will see, among other things, how hyenas hunt and how they deal with the leader who acted to the detriment of the herd.We will also witness a hungry cheetah trying to catch a savannah gazelle.She decides to take a desperate step - she runs away to a river full of crocodiles.They will have a feast, the big cat must enjoy it this time.

programs.title: Untamed Americas
programs.desc: The territory of North and South America stretches over 15,000 kilometers - from the Arctic Archipelago to Tierra del Fuego.No other continent has such breadth and diversity of landscape.Here you can admire the longest mountain chain in the world - the Andes, the Amazon rainforest and the driest area on Earth - the Atacama Desert.Unique species of animals live in these wild areas.The authors hunt grizzly bears, encounter bats with extremely long tongues, jaguars attacking caimans and dolphins swimming among the trees.From cold Alaska, through the tropical Caribbean and the green Amazon - famous actor Josh Brolin takes viewers on this amazing journey.

programs.title: Savage Kingdom: Uprising
programs.desc:
The film is dedicated to a lion named Sekekama.He is the undisputed leader of the pack.However, to maintain power, he must defend his throne against his rivals.These are three eastern princes who want to rule the entire territory.They are ready to overthrow the current king, and each of them may pose a real threat to his position.A new, powerful empire is also created by the dangerous Queens of the North.Three lionesses were once expelled from the pride, and now they tirelessly plan bloody revenge on their enemies.Meanwhile, the lioness Saba struggles with a personal tragedy.At the same time, she constantly works to ensure that the only son she has will follow the path she has set
In distant Botswana, a fierce battle between the lion dynasty is taking place.Animals conspire, plot, plan coups, commit treason and protect their heirs with dedication.The four-episode documentary series brings to mind dramas whose heroes are people.On the African plains, the story of kings, their traitorous sons and mysterious avengers comes to life.The background of the bloody games are stunning landscapes, captured using the latest filming technology.Viewers can see both lightning in the stormy sky above the plain and individual dewdrops on the lion's mane.Game of Thrones One of the main characters of this story, created five years ago, is the aging lion Sekekama.He must constantly guard his position in the herd.He has enemies even among his descendants.In addition, warrior lionesses appeared on the outskirts of his territory, which the authors of the document called the Queens of the North.Three females and eight cubs are able to create a new dynasty that will take over the area.Saba the leopard will also play an important role in the whole story, as she tries to instill the hunter's instinct in her son and teaches him the art of killing.
